faqs.question: Is ezControl Software still supported?
faqs.answer: No, ezControl is no longer supported. Current P4SPR and P4PRO instruments run Affilabs.core instead; labs still on ezControl are encouraged to reach out about upgrading to a compatible instrument.

faqs.question: What is Affilabs.core used for?
faqs.answer: It's the instrument control, data acquisition, and analysis software built for the P4SPR and P4PRO, covering an SPR experiment from first connection through exported data.

faqs.question: What is Sparq?
faqs.answer: Sparq stands for Surface Plasmon Analysis Result Quality, a smart operation support assistant built directly into Affilabs.core that troubleshoots issues step by step without a support ticket.

faqs.question: Does Affilabs.core include regulatory validation?
faqs.answer: Yes, IQ (12 automated checks) and OQ (43 tests across 6 suites) come included with every installation, generating timestamped reports for audits.

faqs.question: Does Affilabs.core need an internet connection to run experiments?
faqs.answer: No, it runs experiments without requiring an internet connection.

faqs.question: What computer specs does Affilabs.core need?
faqs.answer: Windows 10 or 11 (64-bit), a direct USB 2.0 port, 4 GB RAM minimum (8 GB recommended), 500 MB storage, and a 1280 x 800 minimum display resolution.

faqs.question: What formats can data export to?
faqs.answer: Excel, CSV for Origin and Prism, sensorgram images, or directly to the clipboard.

faqs.question: Can I add steps to a method mid-run?
faqs.answer: Yes, the method queue supports multi-step sequences with templates, and steps can be added mid-run.

faqs.question: How does the software catch a bad run in progress?
faqs.answer: Optical fault detection flags leaks and bubbles with a real-time signal quality score as the run happens.

faqs.question: What is the price of Affilabs.core in India?
faqs.answer: Affilabs.core is included with every P4SPR and P4PRO instrument; get in touch and Inkarp will confirm details as part of the instrument quote.

longForm.heroLead: SPR software usually means juggling separate tools for calibration, acquisition, analysis, and export. Affilabs.core handles all of it in one desktop application, built specifically for the P4SPR and P4PRO instruments, with Sparq, a smart operation support assistant, built directly in. A live four-channel sensorgram tracks every cycle in real time, one-click calibration handles servo alignment and LED tuning automatically, and machine learning optimizes those settings further without manual tweaking. IQ/OQ validation ships included with every installation, and when something doesn't work, Sparq walks through the fix step by step, no ticket, no wait.

sections.title: Product Information
sections.description: Affilabs.core product information: acquisition, calibration, analysis, and built-in support.
body: Affilabs.core handles instrument control, data acquisition, and analysis in one desktop application built specifically for the P4SPR and P4PRO instruments.
A live four-channel wavelength plot tracks every run in real time, with automatic injection flags and cycle markers built directly into the view.

Automated calibration handles servo alignment, LED calibration, and S-pol reference capture with a single click, and machine learning further optimizes LED settings and convergence without manual adjustment.
A method queue supports multi-step sequences with templates, and steps can be added mid-run rather than requiring a full restart.
Analysis tools include alignment, ΔSPR cursors, KD fitting, and cycle comparison, all inside the same application used for acquisition.
Data exports directly to Excel, CSV for Origin and Prism, sensorgram images, or the clipboard, no separate conversion step required.
Optical fault detection flags leaks and bubbles with real-time signal quality scoring, catching problems as they happen rather than after a run is wasted.
An experiment notebook tags, annotates, rates, and makes past experiments searchable, keeping a full history without a separate logging system.
IQ/OQ validation ships included with every installation, 12 automated checks for IQ and 43 tests across 6 suites for OQ, generating timestamped qualification reports for regulatory and lab audits.

Sparq, built directly into the software, guides first-time installation, troubleshoots calibration and connectivity issues, answers workflow questions, and escalates to the Affinité team when needed, all without leaving the application.

sections.title: One Application, Every Step
sections.description: Switching between separate tools for calibration, acquisition, and analysis costs time and introduces version mismatches between them. Affilabs.core keeps every step of an SPR experiment in one application, from first connection to exported data.
body: The live sensorgram, method queue, and analysis tools all draw from the same running session, so a cycle comparison or KD fit happens on the exact data just acquired, not a re-imported copy.
Data leaves the application in whatever format the next step needs, Excel or CSV for Origin and Prism, sensorgram images, or a direct clipboard copy, without a separate export utility.
Optical fault detection runs alongside acquisition itself, catching leaks or bubbles with a real-time quality score instead of surfacing the problem only after the run is already wasted.

sections.eyebrow: Sparq: Support Built Into the Software
sections.title: Sparq: Support Built Into the Software
sections.description: A greyed-out button or an unexpected error usually means a support ticket and a wait. Sparq removes that wait entirely by living inside the software itself.
body: It guides first-time installation and driver setup, troubleshoots calibration issues, hardware detection, and connectivity, and answers questions about experimental setup and workflow, all without leaving Affilabs.core.

Log files can be uploaded directly to Sparq to speed up diagnosis, and when a problem needs a human, Sparq escalates to the Affinité team rather than leaving the user stuck. No account is required to get an answer. A greyed-out Start Calibration button, for example, usually just means the software needs updating, and Sparq walks through exactly that fix on the spot.
